artworks.title: The Pleiades (electrotype of Etruscan bronze mirror)
artworks.description: Etruscan and Greek mirror-backs often ring the seven sisters of Atlas in a star-cluster — the collective image in which Celaeno the Pleiad circulates namelessly beside Maia, Electra, and the rest, distinct from the Harpy Celaeno who snatched Phineus' feast.
